task_description: Write the full 9-book Korean-language light novel series 'Omelasian Bible' (오멜라스 성서) into the omelas repo, plus Korean translations of the existing English canon files. All prose in Korean. Total length target: the whole series ~250 pages combined (~27-28 pages per book, using ~450 Korean characters/page => ~110,000-125,000 characters total). Anchored to the in-repo canon (README.md, ideation.md, page-1.md) and an authoritative Korean story bible. Do not push or open PRs.

verification.summary: No build/test system (Korean prose repo); verification is content-based. All 10 features completed and semantic review APPROVED (v3). STRUCTURE: 9 book directories (books/01-revelation .. 09-infancy-gospel), each with 00-index.md + 6 chapter files (54 chapters total). Plus canon/ with 4 files (README-ko.md, ideation-ko.md, page-1-ko.md, story-bible-ko.md). LENGTH: after review-driven expansion, total = 112,786 pure-Hangul glyphs = ~250.6 pages under the story bible's pinned metric (450 glyphs/page); 164,218 total chars incl. spaces. Evenly distributed 12,324-12,821 glyphs per book. LANGUAGE: all 54 chapter files are genuine Korean prose. EM DASHES: none (grep clean across books/ and canon/). CANON PRESERVED: English originals README.md/ideation.md/page-1.md byte-identical to their init commits. REVIEW LOOP: v1 NEEDS_CHANGES (length short, 하윤 name collision, 별이 unregistered) -> fixed in 2421bca; v2 NEEDS_CHANGES (particle-agreement regression from 하윤->연우 rename) -> fixed in 84cda53; v3 APPROVED (only a non-blocking 1-char cosmetic note in the story-bible table).
